subject: Restart daemon to activate note dup guard
description: The note dup guard (DUP_THRESHOLD=0.55 cosine on title vecs) was merged into routes/overlay.js. Restart the daemon at /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid to activate it. Run: cd /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid && node daemon.js (or use the existing restart script/hook). Verify with: curl -X POST http://localhost:8787/overlay/note -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"test dup","summary":"test"}' then POST the same title again — second call should return {ok:false,duplicate:true}.
